chapter: Childhood and first bands in Ohio
title: Joining Zack White's band
summary: He moves to Zack White's band, with Si Oliver as arranger, a good band but outplayed by Speed Webb.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Uh-huh, and Zack White had a very good band. Si Oliver, you know, was the arranger in the band.

And he played the trumpet then. He was playing the trumpet in the band.
It was a nice little band. There was a lot of bands out there in the West, though, that to me that -- you know, someone could play it better, like Speed Webb. Speed Webb came to the Paradise Ballroom in Cincinnati and made us sound bad.
